cues.text: The Moonlight Bridge, during the Dark Hour. A huge Shadow hangs in the arch of one of the bridge's towers, its body spread inside a great ring. On the roadway below, Takaya, shirtless, his long hair down his back, stands looking up at it beside Jin, who holds a briefcase.
You and the others run up the roadway and stop a few metres behind them, taking up fighting stances. Takaya turns around to face you.
Jin squares up to fight, his briefcase in hand.
